guard: Documentary realism, natural skin texture, imperfect practical lighting, real micro-expressions, natural motion timing, no beauty smoothing, no captions, no watermarks, no narration, natural ambient sound only, one single continuous live-action scene, about 5 seconds, landscape 16:9.

scenes.orchard-a: A man in a sunlit kitchen screams in despair at a bag of stale supermarket coffee, flinging it onto the counter beside a drip machine, morning light through the window.
scenes.orchard-b: A suburban mailbox smoking like a chimney; a woman opens it and pulls out a gently steaming fresh coffee package, delighted, while a man jogs up the lawn behind her.
scenes.orchard-c: An old farmer on a green coffee hillside hands a small paper bag of beans to a hovering delivery drone, which lifts away over the rows.
scenes.lantern-a: A man at three in the morning lit only by his laptop, hands pressed to his temples in despair at dozens of open windows, his family asleep in the background.
scenes.lantern-b: A man in rumpled pajamas sprints down a dark server-room corridor clutching an open laptop, panic on his face.
scenes.lantern-c2: A man in bed at night relaxing as his phone glows; a large green terminal banner reading SYSTEM STABLE floats on the screen he holds up.
scenes.harbor-a: A young couple recoils in a bright living room absurdly filled with hundreds of garden gnomes covering every surface.
scenes.harbor-b: A blonde realtor in a navy blazer stands by a crooked hand-painted For Sale sign on a suburban street, checking her phone, unimpressed.
scenes.harbor-c: A realtor in a cream blazer waves from a porch while a neighbor family on the lawn waves back, golden late light.
scenes.quiet-a: A man in bed at two in the morning stares at his phone showing a harsh red sleep score of 32, the glow lighting his tired face.
scenes.quiet-b: A woman in a pink-lit bedroom at night furiously works equations on a chalkboard in her pajamas, determined to fix her sleep score.
scenes.quiet-c: A large black panther deeply asleep on a neatly made bed, yawning once and settling back into the pillows.
scenes.slowroad-a: A couple sprints through a European cathedral square dragging rolling suitcases, scattering pigeons, breathless.
scenes.slowroad-b: A crammed tour group inside a train car all photograph a single cow through the window as fields blur past.
scenes.slowroad-c: Three friends and a grandmother pour wine at a long wooden table in a vineyard at sunset, relaxed and laughing.
